general.notes: Forward error correction (FEC) is required to be implemented by the host. LPO module does not have a CDR. Receiver sensitivity (OMA) is -5.1 dBm for TECQ≤1.4dB per lane; -6.5+TECQ dBm for 1.4dB<TECQ≤3.4dB per lane (Note 2: measured with PRBS31Q, BER@2.4*10^-4). Launch power in OMA each lane: -1.8 dBm for max(TECQ,TDECQ)<1.4dB; -3.2+max(TECQ,TDECQ) dBm for 1.4dB≤max(TECQ,TDECQ)≤3.4dB. Wavelength assignment 1304.5–1317.5 nm suitable for all channels (Note 3). Case operating temperature without air flow. Power dissipation stated as <8.5 W (Typical 7.5W). Link power budget typ 6.7 dB; allocation for penalties (for maximum TDECQ) 3.7 dB. Operating distance 500 m.

general.suggestions: Explicit OSNR and chromatic dispersion tolerances not stated. Receiver sensitivity second row is parametric (-6.5+TECQ dBm) and could not be captured as a single float. Consider schema support for TECQ/TDECQ-conditioned parameters.
